$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId is added after the first deploy.
seoDescription: Search 2,300+ companies hiring on Lever in one run: job titles, salary ranges with pay period, locations, remote work and posting dates. No login or key.
defaultRunOptions$comment: 2048 MB, also the minimum. Measured on Apify at 2048 MB (build 1.0.1, engine v0.4.0, 2026-11-03): the example input took 57.9 s, peaked at 442 MiB and cost $0.0074 (run yBoCIZDTtcAkjBI1E); the empty form 57.2 s, 424 MiB, $0.0074 (run FxhK3ledZa4kIpTMl); each made 2,403 to 2,404 calls and received 84.5 MB, the gzip size, so Cloudflare answered (the api.lever.co fallback sends about 1 GB uncompressed); only 0.0018 GB of external transfer was billed, because it counts outbound traffic. The minimum stays 2048 though Apify peaked near 440 MiB: on the laptop (macOS footprint, about twice what Apify reported for the same inputs) a description search peaked at 996 MiB with 54 s of CPU, and Apify gives 1 GB a quarter of a core and 2 GB half (docs.apify.com/platform/actors/running/usage-and-resources, verified 2026-11-03), so at 1 GB that search would sit near the memory limit and run CPU-bound for minutes, and a run killed for memory still pays the run start. Every job with details (maxJobs 0) fits 2 GB on engine v0.4.1, which delivers one push chunk at a time: 76,508 rows in 144 s at a 932 MiB laptop footprint (453 MiB resident), against 2,923 MiB on v0.4.0. maxMemoryMbytes 4096 only adds CPU. The run start is $0.005 per GB, $0.01 at 2 GB: if the default changes, change the cost lines of README.md and llms.txt with it.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-02 (Store scan of 3,631 listings at 23:14 UTC, prices from GET /v2/acts, last pricingInfos record in force). Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Main competitor: fantastic-jobs/lever-co-jobs-api, the most used actor made for Lever (76 u30): $0.0025 a job on FREE (BRONZE $0.002, SILVER $0.0012, GOLD and up $0.0008), no start fee, one row with the description from its database of jobs posted in the last 6 months, no company list needed. job $0.0022 is 12% under it and job-details $0.0023 8% under it on FREE. Others that name Lever: fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api 1,632 u30 ($0.012 + $0.01 start, 58 ATS database), bovi 100 ($0.0015 + $0.00005, companies or presets), yugenox 86 ($0.002, live keyword search on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby, the closest design), memo23 81 ($0.004 + $0.03), viridian 53 ($0.0015 + $0.00005). Run start, apify-actor-start at $0.005 flat, charged by Apify once up to 1 GB and once more per extra GB ($0.01 at the default 2 GB): Lever has no search, so every search reads all 2,396 job sites whatever it finds, and the start covers that fixed work. Measured on Apify at 2048 MB (build 1.0.1, engine v0.4.0, 2026-11-03, unpriced): the example input took 57.9 s and $0.0074 (run yBoCIZDTtcAkjBI1E), the empty form 57.2 s and $0.0074 (run FxhK3ledZa4kIpTMl), nearly all of it compute (0.032 CU, $0.0064). The 84.5 MB each full pass downloads is inbound and not billed: external transfer is billed on outbound traffic, the calls sent, 0.0018 GB ($0.0004) a run. A 100-row run earns $0.23 on FREE, so its cost is 3% of its price, under the 10% rule; margin at 2 GB 96.0% on FREE and 96.6% on GOLD (orchestrator, 2026-11-03). With the start even a run that saves nothing covers its cost (80% of $0.01 against $0.0074); without it a paid run under 5 rows would lose money. The earlier guard (cut the start to $0.00005 if a measured full pass costs under $0.015) is met at $0.0074; the orchestrator kept every price unchanged on 2026-11-03. A start event can be cut at once later through CI, while adding one needs Console and 14 days. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29 on the two job events; the start stays flat.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, locations, work type, job type, department, team, pay, posting date, job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, pay as numbers with its currency and period, country and country code.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged by Apify when a run starts: once up to 1 GB of memory and once more for each extra GB, so $0.01 at the default 2 GB. It covers the fixed work of reading all 2,396 of Lever's job sites, which every search does whatever it finds.
